name: Owl
otherStatistics: Ability modifiers STR −4, DEX +1, CON −1, INT −4, WIS +1, CHA −2. Perception 13. Stealth 13. Darkvision 120 ft. Languages none.
appearance: A tawny owl with a pale face, patterned plumage, and folded wings.

sections.Traits:
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke an opportunity attack from that enemy.
Heightened Hearing and Sight. Use Perception 18 when relying on hearing or sight.
Quiet Wings. Its Stealth is 18 while it flies.
sections.Actions: Talons. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5 ft. reach, one creature. On a hit, deal 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

appearance: A large, round-headed owl with barred brown plumage, folded wings, and heavy talons.

name: Panther
otherStatistics: Ability modifiers STR +2, DEX +2, CON +0, INT −4, WIS +2, CHA −2. Perception 14. Stealth 16. Darkvision 60 ft. Languages none.
appearance: A black cat with rounded ears, muscular forelegs, and a long curved tail.

sections.Printed source: Pantera, Cubil de Monstruos (Nosolorol, 2025), pp. 349–350. Licensed Spanish edition of Kobold Press’s Monster Vault (2024). https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits:
Heightened Smell. Use Perception 19 when relying on smell.
Pounce. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hitting it with Claw on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength save or fall prone. If the target is prone, the panther may make one Bite attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5 ft. reach, one creature. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5 ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Stealthy Hunter. Take the Hide action.
